title: upstream: check OpenMLS component GREASE uses RFC 9420 set
description: Found in .4.44: OpenMLS random_grease_value picks from the 15 RFC 9420 GREASE values, but mls-extensions-10 §7.5 defines only 8 GREASE component IDs (0x0A0A-0x7A7A); 0x8A8A+ are component Private Use. mimi-mls now uses a §7.5-only generator for component GREASE. Check whether the OpenMLS fork uses random_grease_value for component IDs internally; if so, minimal repro and report upstream only with Mark's OK.
